# au-fpa-pack

> Australian extension of the openfpa FP&A workbench: 30 June financial years, Xero AU mapping, GST and BAS cash timing, and payroll on-cost assumptions, with an agent-facing CLI, a Python kernel and 17 skills. Forecasting aids, not advice; examples use fabricated or public data.

- Names: the distribution is `au-fpa-pack`, the import is `pyfpa` and the console script is `openfpa`. `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` declares the repository as the `openfpa` Claude Code plugin.
- Install: `pip install au-fpa-pack` for the published release (see https://pypi.org/project/au-fpa-pack/), or `uv sync --locked --extra dev` from a clone. Requires Python 3.12 or later.
- Upstream: [openfpa](https://github.com/JeffBrines/openfpa) by Jeff Brines and Guiderail. MIT licensed; both attributions are kept in LICENSE.
- A competent human approves the assumptions and any funding decision. Rates and dates in docs/australian-pack.md are recorded modelling assumptions with sources, not a tax engine.

## What is here

- Kernel (`pyfpa/`): forecast schemas and accounting mechanics (`models/`, `cash13/`, `analysis/`, `config/`, `io/`), verified Excel export (`excel/`), Australian rules (`au/`), forecast scoring and holdouts (`backtest/`), company memory (`memory/`), the champion and challenger loop (`research/`) and cross-client learning (`portfolio/`).
- CLI (`openfpa`): JSON-emitting workspace commands for intake, source registration, mappings, reconciliation, connector scaffolding, corrections, scorecards, context packs and Excel export.
- Skills (`skills/`): 16 `fpa-` skills covering Australian drivers, GST and BAS, payroll, Xero onboarding, model scaffolding, actuals wiring, Excel export, monthly close, cash runway, board briefings, CFO judgement, corrections, backtesting, the research loop and portfolio learning, plus `generated/sku-profitability` as a worked company-specific skill.
- Australian scope: `FY2027`, `Q1 FY2027` and `1H FY2027` labels and dd/mm/yyyy dates; super guarantee, effective-dated payroll tax in all 8 states and territories, workers compensation, leave provisions and contractors; net GST from GST-exclusive series with monthly or quarterly settlement feeding the 13-week cash model.

## Examples

- [Lumbridge Services](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-fpa-pack/tree/main/examples/lumbridge-services): fictional Newcastle NSW maintenance business. A 45-day receipt delay changes cash and receivables without changing profit. The figures come from fabricated records, and no independent accountant has reviewed them. Browser walkthrough: https://duguid.com.au/examples/profit-vs-cash-flow/.
- [Harbour Light](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-fpa-pack/tree/main/examples/harbour-light): synthetic Victorian lighting wholesaler for FY2027, with Xero, payroll and GST fixtures.
- [Keldagrim Forge](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-fpa-pack/tree/main/examples/keldagrim-forge): fictional Hunter Valley metal fabricator used as a timed model drill.
- [Quarter close](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-fpa-pack/tree/main/examples/quarter-close): a fabricated three-month close and cash simulation from 30 September 2026.
- [Supplier invoices to planned cash](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-fpa-pack/tree/main/examples/creditor-cash), [restricted cash planning](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-fpa-pack/tree/main/examples/restricted-cash) and [WIP to project cash](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-fpa-pack/tree/main/examples/job-to-cash).
- [Ridgeline Chair Co.](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-fpa-pack/tree/main/examples/ridgeline): synthetic product company where an inventory build creates a near-term liquidity gap.
- [ARB Corporation](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-fpa-pack/tree/main/examples/arb) (ASX: ARB) and [Fox Factory](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-fpa-pack/tree/main/examples/foxfactory): public-company examples source-traced to published filings. Reproducing reported mechanics shows arithmetic, not forecast skill.
